reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Our flight landed 40 minutes late and the driver was still waiting at arrivals with a name board. Clean Innova, careful driving on the hill road to Darjeeling, and the fare was exactly what the website said.

reviews.author: Rohan M.
reviews.text: Booked Bagdogra to Gangtok on WhatsApp the night before. Got the driver's name and car number in the morning. He knew every tea stop on the way and helped us with the Tsomgo permit the next day.

reviews.author: Ananya D.
reviews.text: Did the 5-night Darjeeling and Gangtok package with my parents. Same driver for the whole trip, hotels as promised, and the office replied within minutes every time we messaged.

reviews.author: Vikram T.
reviews.text: Pelling is a long drive but the driver took it steady and stopped wherever we wanted photos. Fixed fare, tolls included, no last-minute extras.

reviews.author: Meera K.
reviews.text: Good, reliable service from NJP to Kalimpong. Car was a little older than expected but clean and the driver was polite and on time.

reviews.author: Arjun B.
reviews.text: We had to cancel a day before because of a family emergency and the advance was refunded in three days without any argument. Will book again.
